LanguageData.CC_Settings_FaithLife_Tip: With Ideology: how firmly each colonist holds their faith comes into Rimfolk's life. Talks about faith can move a listener's certainty, the council can call an evening of faith or decree one faith for the colony, a hard turn of life can shake someone's faith, and a page shows who believes what and how firmly. Conversions are always the game's own: someone takes a new faith when their certainty runs out.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_FaithLife: Talks, rites and hard times can move a colonist's faith (Ideology).
LanguageData.CC_Faith_ConvertedBy: {PAWN_nameDef} has taken up {FAITH}, leaving {OLD} behind. {OTHER_nameDef} brought {PAWN_objective} round.
LanguageData.CC_FaithBtn_Evening_Tip: Ask {0}'s moral guide, or its most devout believer, to speak this evening. Its believers come to hear it; others decide for themselves, and a good evening can sway them.
LanguageData.CC_FaithBtn_Decree_Tip: Declare "one faith for the colony" for {0}: each day the wavering of other faiths are drawn to it, its believers speak of it more often and council meetings open with a word from it, while everyone else trusts the council a little less until it's lifted.
LanguageData.CC_FaithBtn_Decree_Confirm: Declare {0} the colony's faith? Colonists of other faiths will trust the council a little less every day the decree holds. You can lift it on the decrees page.
LanguageData.CC_FaithBtn_DecreeHeld_Tip: {0} is the colony's faith by decree. Lift it on the decrees page.
LanguageData.CC_FaithBtn_DecreeOther: The council has already named {0} the colony's faith. Lift that decree first.
LanguageData.CC_FaithBtn_NoHome: There's no home for the colony to gather in.
LanguageData.CC_FungusDiet_Made: {0} can keep down only fungus and insect food: their faith makes them throw up anything else. Rimfolk has made a food policy, "{1}", that allows only fungus meals, raw fungus and insect food. Give it to them in the Assign tab, and keep a "cook fungus meal" bill going at a stove.
